fact: The Minister said the ministry runs card production with its own personnel and extended hours, engaging suppliers only on equipment maintenance.
The ministry's Civil and National Registration department is funded with P105 million to produce Omang cards and maintain the Births and Deaths Registration System.

fact: The Department of Civil and National Registration registers applicants and issues the Omang through its own head, regional and district offices and a centralized production center.
